activities.anchor: But the output is always the same shape
activities.caption: pair each physics with its receptor
activities.name: spTransduceMatch

config.prompt: Different sensors, identical output language. Pair each physical quantity with its transduction:

pairs.right: a graded voltage whose size tracks stimulus intensity, becoming spike frequency past threshold

config.why: Every sense converts its physical quantity into the one currency the nervous system can read — and each receptor sits on a labelled line whose activity is always reported as that line's modality and location.

activities.anchor: developmentally a bit of brain, sitting in the eye
activities.caption: file each trait — rods or cones
activities.name: spRodsBuckets

config.prompt: Two photoreceptor families, two jobs. File each trait:

items.label: exquisitely sensitive single-photon detectors for dim light
concentrated in the periphery — why faint stars vanish when you look straight at them
three spectral types — short, medium, long wavelength
what daylight vision and colour run on

config.why: One photon isomerises one retinal molecule inside one rhodopsin — and a G-protein cascade amplifies the catch with a gain of millions.

activities.caption: rebuild the visual hierarchy — photon to stream
activities.name: spVisionOrder

config.prompt: From photon to 'what' and 'where'. Rebuild the stages:
items: Photoreceptors catch photons in the retina
Retinal interneurons compute centre-surround antagonism — edges and contrast over raw illumination
Ganglion-cell axons cross partially at the optic chiasm and relay through the thalamus
V1: edge detectors tuned to particular orientations in particular places
The split: ventral 'what' toward the temporal lobe, dorsal 'where/how' toward the parietal
config.why: From edge detectors the hierarchy climbs to motion direction, faces and whole scenes — and damaging one stream can leave a patient who cannot recognise a face yet navigates the room perfectly.

activities.anchor: The retina is already brain tissue computing edges
activities.caption: find the faulty line — a camera brochure
activities.name: spCameraSpot

config.prompt: A brochure comparing the eye to a camera contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: The retina is developmentally a bit of brain, sitting in the eye.
Its interneurons already compute edges and contrast before anything reaches the cortex.
The eye passes a faithful photograph to a brain that merely displays it.
The blind spot is filled by interpolation — perception is construction, demonstrated on your own retina.
config.correction: Seeing is a construction the whole pathway makes: the retina pre-computes, the blind spot is interpolated, and the eye only supplies sparse data.
config.why: The vision system dominates cortex itself — an estimated third to half of primate cortex is vision-related.

activities.anchor: The outer hair cells are the surprise
activities.caption: fill the blanks — the ear as frequency map
activities.name: spTonotopicCloze

config.text: Each frequency maximally vibrates one place along the basilar membrane: %%0%% frequencies at the base, %%1%% at the apex — the %%2%% principle, preserved all the way to cortex, where the auditory map is literally a map of pitch.
config.hint: Stiff and narrow at one end, loose and wide at the other — which end answers a bass note?

activities.anchor: the system remains the senses' most underrated
activities.caption: call the cast — the olfactory receptor bank
activities.name: smellEstimate

config.prompt: Combinatorial coding turns a modest receptor bank into an enormous odour vocabulary. About how many types of olfactory receptor do humans carry?
config.why: About 400 — each neuron expresses one type, and a single odorant activates a characteristic subset, so the space of possible activations is astronomically larger than the bank.
config.context: Olfaction also bypasses the thalamus — the circuit-level reason smells trigger memory and emotion so forcefully.

config.prompt: Two-point discrimination maps the body's sensor density. Place the marker at the fingertip's resolution:
config.why: About 2–3 mm on the fingertip against about 40 mm on the back — a 15-fold map distortion mirrored exactly in the somatosensory homunculus.

activities.anchor: every illusion is a natural experiment on the construction
activities.caption: scrub the experiments that proved the model
activities.name: spIllusionTimeline

events.title: Gate-control theory
events.text: Melzack and Wall: competing touch signals can close the spinal gate on pain — hence rubbing a knock.

events.title: The invisible gorilla
events.text: Simons and Chabris: attention is the bottleneck, not the eye — how little of the scene is actually encoded.

events.title: A trillion odours
events.text: The famous combinatorial-coding estimate from ~400 receptor types — since debated, but the principle stands.

events.title: 'Controlled hallucination'
events.text: Seth's Being You popularises the predictive-processing frame: perception is the model, corrected by error signals.
